## About
We're Advanced Auto Recyclers, serving the Southfield area with quality used parts. When a new part costs too much, we're a good place to check first.
You can search our inventory online, search by image, or run a multi-part search. Then give us a call or stop by the shop.
We hold a 4.1 rating from 159 Google reviews.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used parts for cars and trucks, sold right here in Southfield.
